species_abilities.description: Racial and species-specific abilities that provide bonuses or unique capabilities in Star Trek Adventures.

abilities.name: Indomitable Will
abilities.effect: Once per session, when you would take a Complication, you may choose to take a Threat instead. Humans are known for their ability to overcome impossible odds.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.effect: You can use any Skill you haven't trained at a -1 penalty, representing human versatility.

abilities.name: Logic
abilities.effect: You may reroll 1 die on any Intelligence or Cunning-based Skill check. Vulcans' logical training allows them to find solutions others miss.

abilities.name: Mental Discipline
abilities.effect: You have +1 to all Empathy-based checks to resist emotional manipulation or psychological attacks.

abilities.name: Vulcan Nerve Pinch
abilities.effect: As a melee attack, you can render a target unconscious with a single touch. Target must pass a Brawn + Resilience check or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Mind Meld
abilities.effect: By placing your hand on a target's face and saying 'It is against the Vulcan tradition to reveal the nature of the mind meld,' you can read the target's memories or implant suggestions. Requires Intelligence + Science vs target's Cunning + Resilience.

abilities.name: Warrior's Blood
abilities.effect: You have +1 to all Brawn-based Skill checks and +1 to your Toughness. Klingons are natural warriors.

abilities.name: Honor in Battle
abilities.effect: When you are the target of a sneak attack or ambush, you may reroll your initiative check. Klingons are always ready for combat.

abilities.name: Bat'leth Mastery
abilities.effect: When wielding a bat'leth, you gain +1 to Weapon Skill checks and deal 1 extra Action Die on a hit.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.effect: Let loose a terrifying war cry. All enemy units within 10 meters must pass a Cunning + Resilience check or be disrupted for 1 round. Allied units within 10 meters gain +1 to their next attack roll.

abilities.name: Deception
abilities.effect: You have +1 to all Cunning-based Skill checks involving stealth, espionage, or deception. Romulans are masters of subterfuge.

abilities.name: Cloaking Technology
abilities.effect: When piloting a Romulan vessel, you may decloak and fire weapons in the same impulse without the telltale decloak signature that Starfleet sensors can detect.

abilities.name: Cold-Blooded
abilities.effect: You are unaffected by cold temperatures and have +1 to Resilience checks in cold environments. Andorians thrive in cold climates.

abilities.name: Antenna Sensitivity
abilities.effect: Your cranial antennae can detect electromagnetic fields. You have +1 to Science checks involving sensor analysis or electronic systems.

abilities.name: Empath
abilities.effect: You can sense the emotions of beings within 10 meters. You have +2 to Empathy-based checks to detect deception or assess emotional states.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: You can communicate telepathically with a target within line of sight. The target must pass a Cunning + Resilience check to resist. Once connected, you can exchange thoughts and images.

abilities.name: Symbiont Host
abilities.effect: If you are a joined Trill, you have access to the memories and skills of your previous hosts. You may use any Skill from a previous host at a -1 penalty. You have +1 to all Intelligence-based checks.

abilities.name: Assimilation Tubey
abilities.effect: Fire an assimilation tube at a target within 5 meters. On hit, the target begins the assimilation process. They must pass a Brawn + Resilience check each round or lose 1 Stress. After 3 failed checks, they are assimilated.

abilities.name: Nanoprobes
abilities.effect: Your nanoprobes continuously repair your systems. At the start of each of your turns, you recover 1 Stress.

abilities.name: Collective Link
abilities.effect: You share sensory input and knowledge with all nearby Borg drones. You have access to any Skill that any nearby drone has.

abilities.name: Adaptive Shielding
abilities.effect: After being hit by a weapon type, your shields adapt. Subsequent attacks with the same weapon type deal 1 less Action Die of damage.

abilities.name: Shapeshifting
abilities.effect: You can assume the form of any humanoid being you have observed. The transformation takes 1 round. While in another form, you have access to that being's appearance and voice, but not their skills or memories.

abilities.name: Fluid Form
abilities.effect: In your natural fluid form, you can flow through small openings, resist physical attacks (attacks against you have +2 to TN), and squeeze through ventilation systems.

abilities.name: Divide
abilities.effect: You can split into two separate entities, each with half your capabilities. Both entities share consciousness and can remerge at will.

abilities.name: Ketracel-White Enhancement
abilities.effect: While under the influence of Ketracel-white, you have +2 to all Brawn-based checks, +1 to Toughness, and ignore the first 2 Stress you would take. Without Ketracel-white, you suffer withdrawal: -2 to all checks and take 1 Stress per hour.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.effect: Your enhanced biology allows rapid healing. At the start of each combat round, you recover 1 Stress if you have Ketracel-white in your system.

abilities.name: Absolute Loyalty
abilities.effect: You cannot be intimidated, coerced, or mind-controlled. Your loyalty to the Dominion is absolute.

ship_systems.description: Special starship systems and technologies that provide unique capabilities in space combat.

effects.name: Shield Modulation
effects.effect: As a ship action, modulate shield frequency to resist a specific weapon type. Incoming attacks of that type deal 1 less Action Die of damage. Lasts until the end of the next round.

effects.name: Directional Shields
effects.effect: Redirect shield power to one arc (Forward, Aft, or Broadside). Shields in that arc are doubled; shields in other arcs are halved.

effects.name: Shield Inversion
effects.effect: As a desperate measure, invert the shields inside the hull for 1 impulse. The next weapon that hits the ship deals double damage to the attacker's weapon system. Then shields are offline for 1d4 impulses.

effects.name: Shield Regeneration
effects.effect: When not taking damage, shields regenerate 10% of their maximum capacity per impulse.

cloaking_device.name: Cloaking Device
cloaking_device.description: Renders the ship invisible to conventional sensors. Primarily used by Romulans and Klingons.

effects.name: Cloak
effects.effect: The ship becomes invisible to sensors. Attacks against the cloaked ship have +4 to TN. The ship can maintain cloak while moving at impulse but not warp (Romulan technology allows warp while cloaked).

effects.name: Decloak and Fire
effects.effect: The ship may decloak, fire weapons, and recloak in the same impulse. However, the decloak signature is detectable, and the ship is vulnerable for that impulse.

effects.name: Cloak Detection
effects.effect: Advanced sensors (like those on the Enterprise) can detect the subtle distortions caused by a cloaked ship. The sensor operator rolls Intelligence + Science vs the pilot's Cunning + Starship Operations.

warp_drive.name: Warp Drive
warp_drive.description: Enables faster-than-light travel by creating a warp bubble around the ship.

effects.name: Warp Travel
effects.effect: At warp, a ship can traverse interstellar distances in hours or days instead of years. Warp factor determines speed: Warp 6 = 402x light speed, Warp 8 = 512x, Warp 9 = 1512x.

effects.name: Warp Core Breach
effects.effect: If the warp core is critically damaged, it will breach, causing a catastrophic explosion. The crew has approximately 20 minutes to evacuate before the breach occurs.

effects.name: Warp Core Trek
effects.effect: As a last resort, the warp core can be ejected and detonated as a weapon. The resulting explosion deals massive damage to all ships within range.

transporter.name: Transporter
transporter.description: Dematerializes matter and energy, transmits it, and rematerializes it at a destination.

effects.name: Beam Over
effects.effect: Transport personnel or objects between the ship and a planet surface or another ship. Range: up to 40,000 kilometers.

effects.name: Emergency Transporter
effects.effect: In an emergency, the transporter can beam out injured crewmates without precise coordinates. The target materializes in the nearest available transporter room.

effects.name: Transporter Interference
effects.effect: Warp cores, plasma storms, and certain alien technologies can interfere with transporter function, causing failed beam-outs or matter/anti-matter displacement.

holodeck.name: Holodeck
holodeck.description: Creates fully immersive holographic environments with matter simulation.

effects.name: Simulation
effects.effect: Create any environment for training, recreation, or scientific study. Holographic objects can be programmed to feel solid and interact with the physical world.

effects.name: Emergency Medical Hologram
effects.effect: The EMH (The Doctor) is a holographic program that can function independently, providing medical treatment even during red alert.

effects.name: Holodeck Malfunction
effects.effect: If the holodeck malfunctions, holographic objects can become trapped in the physical world, and the environment can become dangerous.

red_matter.name: Red Matter
red_matter.description: A rare substance that can trigger a controlled supernova, creating an artificial singularity (black hole).

effects.name: Singularity Creation
effects.effect: When detonated, red matter creates a black hole that consumes everything in its path. The black hole can be controlled or directed, but is extremely dangerous.

effects.name: Planet Destruction
effects.effect: A red matter detonation can destroy an entire planet by triggering its core to collapse into a singularity.

leader_abilities.description: Unique leader abilities for iconic Star Trek captains and officers.

abilities.name: The Kirk Maneuver
abilities.effect: Execute a daring and seemingly impossible maneuver. The ship can make a movement action at double speed, and the next attack this round deals 1 extra Action Die. However, the crew takes 1 Stress from the strain.

abilities.name: Inspiring Leadership
abilities.effect: All crew members within the ship gain +1 to Empathy-based checks. Kirk's charisma and confidence inspire his crew to perform at their best.

abilities.name: Instinctive Decision-Making
abilities.effect: Once per session, when faced with a critical decision, Kirk can make an instinctive choice that automatically succeeds, representing his uncanny ability to do the right thing.

abilities.name: Logical Analysis
abilities.effect: Spock analyzes a situation and identifies the optimal solution. All crew members gain +1 to their next Skill check related to the analyzed situation.

abilities.name: Vulcan Mind Meld
abilities.effect: Spock performs a mind meld with a target to extract information or heal psychological trauma. The target must pass a Cunning + Resilience check to resist.

abilities.name: Half-Human Emotion
abilities.effect: Spock's human heritage allows him to understand and connect with emotions, even if he cannot fully express them. He has +1 to all Empathy-based checks.

abilities.name: Picard Maneuver
abilities.effect: Picard orders a precise and calculated maneuver that positions the ship for a tactical advantage. The ship gains +2 to its next defense roll and +1 to its next attack roll.

abilities.name: Picard's Whisper
abilities.effect: Picard speaks in a calm, authoritative tone that compels compliance. A target must pass an Empathy + Resilience check or be compelled to follow a simple, reasonable command.

abilities.name: Diplomatic Immunity
abilities.effect: Picard's reputation as a diplomat means that hostile forces are more likely to negotiate than fight. When Picard is on the bridge, enemies may choose to parley instead of attacking.

abilities.name: Scholar's Knowledge
abilities.effect: Picard's vast knowledge of alien cultures and history gives him +2 to all Intelligence-based checks involving xenolinguistics, archaeology, or cultural analysis.

abilities.name: Emissary of the Prophets
abilities.effect: As the Emissary, Sisko has a connection to the Prophets (Bajoran Gods). Once per session, he can call upon their aid to automatically succeed on a critical check or gain forewarning of a threat.

abilities.name: Station Commander
abilities.effect: When defending Deep Space 9, Sisko gains +2 to all Starship Command checks. His knowledge of the station and its defenses is unmatched.

abilities.name: Military Background
abilities.effect: Sisko's Starfleet Academy and military experience give him +1 to all Weapon Skill and Starship Command checks.

abilities.name: Scientific Curiosity
abilities.effect: Janeway's scientific background gives her +2 to all Science checks. She can identify alien technology and biological phenomena more easily than most officers.

abilities.name: Determination
abilities.effect: Janeway's determination to bring Voyager home gives all crew members +1 to checks made while trying to find a way home or overcome obstacles in the Delta Quadrant.

abilities.name: Moral Compass
abilities.effect: Janeway's strong moral principles mean she will never order an action that violates her ethics. However, this can sometimes limit her options in difficult situations.

abilities.name: Klingon Warrior
abilities.effect: Worf has +2 to all Brawn-based Weapon Skill checks and +1 to Toughness. He is one of the most skilled Klingon warriors to serve in Starfleet.

abilities.name: Bat'leth Mastery
abilities.effect: When wielding a bat'leth, Worf deals 2 extra Action Dice on a hit and can disarm opponents with a successful melee attack.

abilities.name: Security Chief
abilities.effect: When Worf is on the bridge, the ship's security team gains +1 to all Security checks. His presence alone deters mutiny and sabotage.

abilities.name: Chancellor's Authority
abilities.effect: As Klingon Chancellor, Martok can call upon the Klingon Defense Force for support. Once per session, he can summon a Klingon reinforcement fleet.

abilities.name: Battle Scars
abilities.effect: Martok's battle scars represent his experience. He has +1 to all Resilience checks and ignores the first Threat he would take each session.

abilities.name: Pah-wraith Empowerment
abilities.effect: Empowered by the Pah-wraiths, Dukat has enhanced strength and resilience. He gains +2 to all Brawn-based checks and is immune to fear and intimidation.

abilities.name: Charismatic Tyrant
abilities.effect: Dukat's charisma and ruthlessness inspire loyalty in his followers. Cardassian and Dominion forces under his command gain +1 to all checks.

abilities.name: Obsidian Order Training
abilities.effect: Dukat's training in the Obsidian Order gives him +2 to all Security checks involving espionage, interrogation, and sabotage.

abilities.name: Borg Interface
abilities.effect: Seven can interface with Borg technology to hack systems, extract data, or disable defenses. She rolls Intelligence + Computer Programming vs the system's difficulty.

abilities.name: Augmented Physiology
abilities.effect: Seven's Borg augmentations give her enhanced strength, speed, and reflexes. She has +1 to all Brawn and Agility-based checks.

abilities.name: Tactical Drone Training
abilities.effect: Seven's experience as a tactical drone gives her +2 to all Weapon Skill checks and +1 to Starship Command checks involving combat tactics.

abilities.name: Reclaiming Humanity
abilities.effect: Seven's journey back to humanity gives her +1 to all Empathy-based checks. She is learning to understand and express emotions.

unit_keywords.description: Common unit keywords and abilities found across Star Trek tabletop games.

keywords.name: Starfleet
keywords.effect: Unit is a member of Starfleet. Gains bonuses when operating with other Starfleet units and can use Starfleet technology.

keywords.name: Klingon Warrior
keywords.effect: Unit is a trained Klingon warrior. Gains bonuses in melee combat and has resistance to fear and intimidation.

keywords.name: Cloaked
keywords.effect: Unit is invisible to conventional sensors. Attacks against the unit have +4 to TN. The unit can decloak to attack.

keywords.name: Shielded
keywords.effect: Unit has deflector shields that absorb damage before hull. Shields regenerate when not under fire.

keywords.name: Warp Capable
keywords.effect: Unit can travel at faster-than-light speeds using warp drive.

keywords.name: Transporter
keywords.effect: Unit has access to transporter technology for personnel and cargo transfer.

keywords.name: Borg Drone
keywords.effect: Unit is a member of the Borg Collective. Shares knowledge and abilities with nearby drones. Can assimilate targets.

keywords.name: Changeling
keywords.effect: Unit can shapeshift into other forms. Has resistance to physical attacks in fluid form.

keywords.name: Jem'Hadar
keywords.effect: Unit is a Jem'Hadar warrior. Has enhanced abilities when under the influence of Ketracel-white.

keywords.name: Vorta
keywords.effect: Unit is a Vorta supervisor. Has diplomatic and administrative abilities. Serves the Founders.

keywords.name: Holodeck
keywords.effect: Unit is a holographic projection. Cannot be physically harmed but can be disrupted by electromagnetic interference.

keywords.name: Android
keywords.effect: Unit is a synthetic being (like Data). Has superhuman strength, speed, and processing power. Does not require air, food, or water.

keywords.name: Prophet
keywords.effect: Unit is a non-corporeal being from the Gamma Quadrant. Exists outside normal time and space. Can manipulate the wormhole.

keywords.name: Prime Directive
keywords.effect: Unit is bound by the Prime Directive and cannot interfere with pre-warp civilizations. Violating the directive has serious consequences.

keywords.name: Red Alert
keywords.effect: Unit is on red alert. All systems are at maximum readiness. Crew gains +1 to combat-related checks but takes 1 Stress per hour.
